entryQuery.zeroValueSemantics: A present TAX_RESULT of 0.0000 is data and is never producer-missing.
entryQuery.missingProducerSemantics: Missing admitted typed tax fact is PRODUCER_UNAVAILABLE and yields deterministic partial completeness without inventing zero.
entryQuery.stableJoin: Tax and social facts join only by the exact same tenant, run, attempt and workerResultId.

typedFact.identity: tenant-first composite identity plus public UUID
typedFact.workerLineage: exact V50 tenant, run, attempt and workerResultId
typedFact.packLineage: exact V53 signed snapshot and ACTIVE activation revision for the same scope and effective date
typedFact.money: NUMERIC(19,4) with explicit currency and application-declared rounding
typedFact.sourceReconciliation: source line public identity, revision and canonical digest
typedFact.replay: same identity and digest is a no-op
typedFact.conflict: same identity with a different digest fails closed

forbidden: Renaming V50 DEDUCTION or control totals as TAX_RESULT.
Weakening the V53 SOCIAL_INSURANCE constraint or ownership boundary.
Changing or re-emitting PayrollCalculated.v1, whose payload stays runId, attemptNo, workerCount, resultDigest and controlTotals.
Creating a PAY-005 command receipt, generic audit store, outbox or tax-specific event.
Hardcoding an official legal rate, filing rule, provider credential or tenant-specific policy.
Mounting a new route or menu, enabling the feature, enrolling a tenant or claiming production readiness.

sourceEvidenceBoundary.claimAllowed: Use the approved family SHA-256 and sixteen-row semantic successor.
sourceEvidenceBoundary.claimForbidden: Do not claim that the sixteen original SKKF source rows were directly reread in this execution.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: IAQ-048 preserves the accepted method, browser and owner paths, canonical route, TAX_SOCIAL_INSURANCE variant, stable workerResultId and empty availableActions while exposing exactly TAX_RESULT, SOCIAL_INSURANCE and POLICY_VERSION in the sealed order.
The authoritative item set and tax/social union rule are tenant, run, attempt and workerResultId exact; filtering, sorting and cursor behavior remain deterministic.
A real zero tax amount is distinct from missing producer data, and COMPLETE, EMPTY, PARTIAL and UNAVAILABLE completeness and cardinality are deterministic.
Tax filters, sorts and revision-bound cursors use real TAX_RESULT values with stable workerResultId tie-breaking and reject stale scope or authorization revisions.
Trusted tenant, exact population scope, VIEW, MASK and OMIT plus field-decision summaries are enforced before serialization; denied and cross-tenant reads fail closed.
Tax and social facts agree on explicit currency, effective policy period and the exact active signed country-pack revision for the same scope and effective date.
TAX_RESULT facts are append-only and exactly source-line reconciled with canonical digests.
Same-digest replay has no duplicate effect and reuse of the same source identity with a different digest conflicts.
Generic V50 deduction or control totals are never relabeled as TAX_RESULT and V53 SOCIAL_INSURANCE ownership or constraints are not weakened.
PAY-003, PAY-011 and PAY-012 ownership and PayrollCalculated.v1 remain unchanged and are not recounted; PAY-005 creates no command receipt, generic audit table, outbox or tax-specific event.

Payroll V57 creates exactly pay_tax_result_facts, preserves V1 through V56 byte-for-byte, has tenant-first same-tenant identity, least-privilege grants, ENABLE plus FORCE RLS and immutable guards, and passes clean-through-V57 plus V56-to-V57 PostgreSQL validation.

The frontend proves loading, empty, partial, unavailable, denied, stale and complete states, accessibility, responsive widths, themes and feature-OFF zero calls; production activation remains barred before official rate, rounding, filing, statutory-golden and legal-signoff evidence.
